# My Apartment Water Quality

> Free lookup of water hardness for US apartments and condos by zip code. Reports use utility and municipal data, with verified readings marked separately from estimates.

## Tool

- [Water hardness lookup](https://www.myapartmentwaterquality.com/): enter a zip code, get a hardness report for that area
